exposure: heart diseases in pregnancy (Peripartum cardiomyopathy, rheumatic heart disease, prosthetic valve disease, acyanotic congenital heart disease)
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with heart disease.
finding: Heart diseases in pregnancy significantly impact both maternal and neonatal outcomes, with higher mortality and complications in women with an ejection fraction of <30%.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was achieved in 66.67% of cases, while 27.78% underwent cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW) was an observed outcome in 52.78% of infants.
gest_age: Preterm birth (77.78%) and small for gestational age (SGA) (30.56%) were observed outcomes for infants; mothers presented between 32 and 37 weeks of gestation.
